entities.summary: Audrey Patrice Marks has served two terms as Jamaica's Ambassador to the United States from 2010 to 2012 and again starting in 2016 until 2025. She is Jamaica's first female Ambassador to the US and the first individual to hold the position twice in two separate terms. She simultaneously serves as Jamaica's permanent representative to the Organization of American States.
